articles.title: TITANVERSE: How to Set Up a Service in TITANVERSE
articles.content:
Feature Overview

The Service Setup feature enables pharmacy teams to configure consultation-based services comprehensively. It ensures that users, rooms, consultations, and communications are aligned before offering services to patients.

Prerequisites

Before creating a service, prepare these items:
- Rooms added to each location (physical or virtual spaces)
- Teams created
- Users invited and availability set
- Consultation Template created
- Pre-Consult (optional) created
- Email & SMS templates prepared

Step-by-Step Instructions

1. Log in to TITANVERSE using your credentials
2. Select the settings cog at the top right-hand side
3. Select 'Services' tab
4. Select 'Add Service'
5. Enter Service name
6. Enter Service cost (Optional)
7. Select the slider for Room required (Optional)
8. Enable group booking or pre-payments within booking options if needed
9. Enter Duration of the Service
10. Assignment:
    - Assign a room if required (multiple rooms possible)
    - Assign Pharmacist to complete Service (multiple pharmacists possible)
11. Select Email confirmation template
12. Select Email Cancellation template
13. Select SMS confirmation template
14. Select SMS cancellation template
15. Select Email reminder template
16. Select SMS reminder template
17. Select Pre-Consult template
18. Select Default Consultation template
19. Select availability of the Service:
    - Select days of the week the Service is offered
    - Select the time frame the service is offered
    - Add multiple times (Optional)
    - Turn off the slider for days the service is not offered
    - Select 'Save Service'

Recommended Setup Sequence

1. Create Consultation Template
2. Create Pre-Consult (Optional)
3. Create Email & SMS Templates
4. Create Service

Top Tips & Best Practices

- Use consistent naming across templates
- Confirm user availability has been set before setting your service live
- Test the full flow before launch
- Review templates regularly

articles.title: TITANVERSE: How To Setup Consultation Templates

9. Review the template information
10. Review and edit the generated Notes Template
11. Review and edit the Structured Questions
12. Configure Consultation Actions
13. Configure Template Settings - ensure status is Active
14. Select 'save template'

articles.title: TITANVERSE: How to Create and Manage Roles
articles.content:
Three default roles cannot be edited: Admin, Pharmacist, Non-Pharmacist.

How to Create a Role:
1. Select Settings cog
2. Click Roles
3. Select Create Role
4. Enter Role Name and Description
5. Toggle permission sliders (grey=OFF, black=ON)
6. Click Save

Permissions include: Templates, Patients, Consultations, Prescriptions, Teams, Users, Calendar, Admin (Full System Access), Approval, Documents, Settings.

articles.title: TITANVERSE: How to Setup Pre-Consult Template
articles.content:
Navigate to Settings cog > Templates > Pre-Consult > Create Template.

Three options for creating pre-consult forms:
1. Choose from existing consultation templates
2. Use AI generation with document upload
3. Manually create using the Builder tool

Templates are active by default. Toggle slider to disable. If a service doesn't require pre-consultation, the pre-consult tab won't appear during consultation.

articles.title: TITANVERSE: How To Setup Email and SMS Templates
articles.content:
Settings cog > Templates > Email/SMS Templates > Add Template.

Enter template name, choose Email or SMS, select template type, add subject (email only), insert placeholders, compose message, click Create Template.

Once created, assign to a service during service creation.

articles.title: TITANVERSE: How to Access and Use the Marketplace
articles.content:
The TITANVERSE Marketplace enables access to integrations that extend platform functionality. Available exclusively to customers on the consultation plan (NMS-only plan users cannot view this feature).

Available Integrations:
- DemDx: Clinical decision support, symptom-led pathways, 500+ conditions. Requires licence key from DemDx.
- Ryft: Online payment processing for card transactions via TITANVERSE iframe.
- PharmAppy: Connects via API key generated within the Marketplace.

articles.title: TITANVERSE: iFrame
articles.content: Settings > Services > View iFrame code. Copy the iFrame code and paste into website HTML to enable appointment booking directly on the pharmacy website. Patients can view and book services without leaving the web domain.

articles.title: TITANVERSE: Billing
articles.content:
Access via Settings tab. Three sections:
1. This Billing Period - current month's usage, plan breakdown, promotional credits, consultation costs with expandable details.
2. Subscriptions - view contract type, add/remove user packs, monitor user utilization.
3. Invoices - view and export all historical invoices.

articles.title: TITANVERSE: How To Install The Ryft Integration
articles.content:
Settings > Market Place > View Details on Ryft > Install App > Select Locations > Install.

Fee: platform fee + 1.25% + 10p per transaction. Customers using PharmAppy Websites don't need separate Ryft integration.

articles.title: TITANVERSE: How to Install DemDx
articles.content: Settings > Market Place > View Details on DemDx > Add more users > Select user > Configure > Enter licence key (from DemDx portal) > Save licence. Each team member needs an individual licence key. After setup, DemDx presenting complaint templates appear in consultation template dropdown.

articles.title: TITANVERSE: How to Install the PharmAppy Integration and Access the Configuration Key
articles.content: Settings > Marketplace > Find PharmAppy > View Details > Install > Configure > Copy configuration key > Provide key to PharmAppy to finalize integration. The key is required to connect TITANVERSE with PharmAppy for seamless data exchange.
